# A gold coin, r 0.22, 0.09 thick, its face to the camera; the rim a step darker.
# Origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Face --base-color 1.000 0.894 0.471 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.949 0.651 0.369 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Coin --vertices 12 --radius 0.2200 --depth 0.0900 --location 0.0000 0.0000 0.0000 --rotation 90 15.00 0
material assign Face
active Coin
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) < 0.5"
material assign Rim
mode object
shade flat
export coin.glb
